name: Historic Centre of Kraków
description: Kraków's old centre in southern Poland grew around its vast Main Market Square, the largest medieval town square in Europe, where the Renaissance Cloth Hall and the twin-towered St. Mary's Basilica stand. Nearby are the Gothic cathedral of Wawel Hill, where Polish kings were buried, and Kazimierz with its old synagogues. Traces of the medieval walls and the Barbican still survive.
